Streamlin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ed workbench with session management, streaming Markdown, slash commands, plugin center, and zero-de"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ployment runtime — no WebUI served, no Harness setup"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A native VS Code coding-agent extension powered by DeepSeek Harness. Install the platform-specific V"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"SIX and start working—there is no upstream repository to clone, no Node/npm setup, and no local Harn"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ess deployment to manage."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Community-maintained **0.6.2 stable extension release**, bundling the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0"},{"id":"p5s2","text":".2.2-rc.1` package (Typert Remote protocol) and standalone Node `24.22.2`. The bundled DSH runtime i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s a release candidate, and DeepSeek Harness remains a Developer Preview."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This release unifies saved session history with official DSH, groups conversations by their original"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" project folder, adds native MCP management, and fixes duplicate or out-of-order prompts. See the Ch"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"inese release notes."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Runtime upgrade:** Harness now uses session format V4. Supported older logs are migrated on resu"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"me into a new generation while their original files are preserved. Old runtimes cannot read the new "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"V4 generation; back up the shared history home (default `~/.dsh`) and the private `~/.dsh/vscode/har"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ness-home` before upgrading, and do not downgrade an active profile. Third-party plugins using the r"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"emoved `ctx.agent` or runtime `Inbox` APIs need their own compatibility updates. The extension keeps"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" its native VS Code interface rather than embedding the official Web UI."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Startup uses the official runtime package resolver. Only a recognized legacy module conflict trigger"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"s one bounded backup-and-repair attempt; ordinary profile packages are no longer moved on every star"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tup or installation."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 0.6.2 release update"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This update aligns the workbench with DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **One saved-history store:** new sessions use the selected shared `sessions/` directory, normally "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`~/.dsh/sessions`. Readable legacy histories migrate with their originals retained; an incompatible "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"record no longer switches the extension to a private store. The history panel shows the actual path "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"and migration details.
- **Project-based session management:** conversations belong to their origina"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"l folder across clients. Browse other projects, preview without activating an Agent, and choose **Co"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ntinue here** to request native execution ownership. New conversations work directly in the selected"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" folder; existing worktrees retain manual actions.
- **Native changes and titles:** per-turn snapsho"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ts and diffs use `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes`. Titles are read from native logs and retained"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" across partial or stale metadata updates.
- **MCP management:** add, edit, enable, disable and remo"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ve stdio or Streamable HTTP servers through **More → MCP servers** or the command palette. Changes a"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"re validated and wait for idle model turns before reloading the Host.
- **Conversation and compatibi"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"lity fixes:** attached editor context no longer duplicates prompts after answers; streaming and queu"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"ed prompts keep their order. The bundled chat importer is updated to `0.26.4`, with known-version up"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"grades preserving its enabled state.
- **Platform packages:** CI tests and builds `darwin-arm64`, `w"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"in32-x64`, `linux-x64` and `linux-arm64`. Unused Office preview and experimental voice resources rem"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"ain excluded; sizes are shown on the release assets."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Download the VSIX from the v0.6.2 release and reload VS Code after installation. GitHub Actions buil"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ds and publishes the four platform packages when the release tag is pushed. Marketplace publication "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"is separate. Release notes are available in Chinese in the changelog."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Native VS Code workbench** — all interaction happens in the sidebar; the local Harness Gateway e"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"xposes only the loopback API transport, while the official WebUI is neither served nor embedded.
- *"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"*First-run guidance** — an unconfigured key shows a three-step setup hint with a direct link to conn"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ection settings; history previews show the original project and execution directory before continuat"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ion.
- **Shared local history** — the bundled runtime and an independently installed official DSH ca"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"n read the same saved conversations. Installing the official CLI is optional; credentials and plugin"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" profiles stay separate.
- **Detachable workbench** — open the same synchronized conversation UI in "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"an editor-area panel and move it to another VS Code window when more space is needed.
- **Complete s"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ession workflow** — persistent history, create, switch, rename, fork, resume, archive/restore, expor"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"t, and import sessions (official DSH ZIP, ChatGPT export ZIP, and other agent transcripts via `dsh-c"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"hat-import`); a started conversation keeps its preset; model and reasoning choices remain editable, "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"and another preset requires an explicitly created conversation.
- **Streaming Markdown** — headings,"},{"id":"p14s13","text":" lists, tables, code blocks, copy controls, safe external links, and clickable workspace file refere"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"nces.
- **Stable incremental rendering** — streamed updates preserve disclosure state and the reader"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"'s scroll position.
- **Progressive reasoning timeline** — nodes appear as thinking steps arrive, co"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"nnecting only existing steps within the same turn. Completed turns retain their timeline inside the "},{"id":"p14s17","text":"expandable process section.
- **Session titles** — automatic titles and manual renames are owned by "},{"id":"p14s18","text":"the official session service.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security and privacy"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- The Harness Gateway listens only on a random `127.0.0.1` port.
- The Webview uses a strict CSP and"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" loads no remote scripts or iframes.
- Plugin catalog JSON is fetched by the Extension Host, validat"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ed into a narrow UI data model, and rendered with `textContent`.
- Raw Markdown HTML is disabled, an"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"d rendered markup is sanitized through a DOMPurify allowlist.
- Remote Markdown images are disabled;"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" http(s) links are validated again by the extension host.
- File and command access is controlled by"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" `permissionMode` and Harness approval policies.
- The API Key is never sent to the Webview or writt"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"en to extension logs.
- Third-party DSH plugins are trusted Extension Host dependencies: they run ou"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"tside the Agent sandbox. Review their source before installation."}],"truncated":true}
